fields.title: Input columns
fields.description:
The input columns to use. They are used in the order visible in the configuration,
which is the order they appear in the input table.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Remove input columns
fields.description: When checked, the input columns will be filtered out from the output.

fields.title: Fail on missing values
fields.description:
When checked, the execution will fail when there is a missing value in the input columns;
otherwise, those cells will be replaced with 0.

fields.title: Fail on values outside [0,255]
fields.description:
When checked, the execution will fail when there is a value in the input columns which is less
than 0 or greater than 255; otherwise, those cells will be replaced with 0.

fields.title: Output column
fields.description: The name of the output column.
